description: Skill orchestration hooks: (1) research-catalog reminder after external fetches, (2) PostToolUse chains (wrap-up→implementation-review, staleness-audit→release-check), (3) PreToolUse gate (atdd-plan requires codebase-explore first). Note: intake→atdd-plan handoff is handled inside intake's Step 6 via the [work-prep] prefix convention, not by a hook.
